params.note: TP is set per grid order as GridStep or TakeProfit points from order price

other_exits: Grid orders close at their individual TP levels; no global SL - the grid relies on averaging entry prices across multiple levels

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Multiple limit orders placed at calculated grid levels around current price; lot size is fixed per level but total exposure scales with number of triggered grid levels

custom_logic_notes: Simple Grid EA: Places buy limit orders below current price and sell limit orders above current price at regular intervals (GridStep). Each grid order has a take profit set at GridStep or TakeProfit distance. When price moves against the grid, additional levels get triggered averaging the entry. No stop loss - risk is unlimited in trending markets. The EA re-creates grid levels as orders are filled or cancelled. This is a classic symmetric grid strategy that profits from ranging markets but carries significant drawdown risk in trends.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategy with pending order management is classified mt5_only because: (1) Multiple overlapping pending orders need native MT5 order management, (2) Grid-level recalculation and order replacement on each tick is MT5-specific, (3) No SL means unlimited risk that requires real margin management, (4) Position stacking across grid levels makes Python backtesting unreliable without tick-level simulation. If conversion is attempted, must implement full grid order book simulation with margin tracking, order fill logic at each grid level, and TP per-level calculation. Cannot use simple bar-based backtesting.
